english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for the group of undergarments worn under outer clothes, especially underpants and bras.

examples.english: Pack your underwear first; don't forget it when we go to the beach tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 執好底衫褲先，聽日去沙灘唔好唔記得。
